blocks.html: The Borrower is a UK headquartered global market research, insight and data analytics company, with a very diversified client base, ryrily across the Consumer Goods, Technology Media & Telecommunications, Financial Services and Automotive industries. The Borrower specialises in providing its business customers with strategic information such as consumer shopping patterns, media audience analysis and consumer behavioural data. DTM enables secure, efficient and legally binding workflows often replacing manual paper-based processes with electronic signatures, identity verifications, digital certificates, and comprehensive audit trails. The Company offers end-to-end DTM services that are considered “compliance-critical” by its customers across various segments and industry verticals. DTM services tend to be embedded within client workflows, which typically makes them difficult to replace. blocks.html: Headquartered in the UK, Freeze (the “Company”) is one of the world’s leading ice cream manufacturers. The Company manufactures and distributes an internationally recognised portfolio of licensed and own brand ice creams as well as providing private-label manufacturing for food retailers’ own labels. Operating primarily across the Northern hemisphere, the Company holds market-leading (#1 or #2) positions in 25 countries. The Company’s core marketing focus is on premium “A-Brands” which contribute 70% of revenue, followed by non-core region-specific brands (~20%) and the remainder from private label manufacturing. The Company was formed as a joint venture between a PE-owned European ice cream manufacturer and parts of a global consumer goods company’s frozen food business. The Company is diversified across geographies and customers, with no customer representing >5% of revenue and top 10 customers accounting for ~30% of revenue

blocks.html: Headquartered in Switzerland, the Company is a pan-European provider of direct-to-consumer dental services operating 620+ clinics and 50 laboratories across 11 European countries and treating 6m+ patients through c. 12.5k professionals. The Company has an established position across Europe, holding leading positions across its footprint (#1 in 5 countries and #2 in 3 others). Revenues are generated through a variety of dental practices and treatments including General Practice Dentistry (~30%), Implantology (~25%), Maxillofacial Surgery (~15%), Dental Hygiene (~15%), Orthodontics (~10%) and Dental Technician Services (~5%). The Company derives the majority of revenues from customers aged over 50 years with higher disposable income due to their demand for its offerings including implants and advanced treatments.

Earnings are well diversified by geography with the largest country comprising less than 20% of revenues. The Dental market has shown resilient growth of 2–4% p.a., underpinned by ageing demographics and increased oral health awareness. The Company also operates in developed European economies with higher disposable incomes and mature regulatory environments. blocks.html: Headquartered in Germany, Box (the “Company”) is a market leading provider of reusable plastic containers for the food industry. The Company manufactures and rents out the foldable, stackable, and displayable containers to food retailers, operating a pooling model which includes cleaning and repair services. The Company offers food retailers an alternative to single-use boxes by providing a comprehensive solution encompassing the full supply chain in a closed-loop circular system. Whilst offering products to suit all perishable goods, Fruit & Vegetable containers overwhelmingly dominate the Company’s volumes at 88% of FY25 recollection. The grocery supply chain packaging and logistics market is dominated by single-use cardboard packaging (81%) with the Company’s segment representing only 10%. The adoption of pooling systems globally is the limiting factor to their expansion with even the most mature market, Europe, at 25-30% penetration. Smaller markets in which they operate like South America and Japan have only 5-10% penetration yet the Company’s market share is 73 and 96% respectively.
